The [[Spacer/Legends|space-farer]] [[Tuner Ryna]] owned a '''starship''' in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], he found [[Yeep]] the [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]] onboard. He was unsure whether "Yeep" referred to the stowaway's name, [[Species/Legends|species]], or chest, but he nevertheless entered Yeep in the annual [[Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings]] race on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]].
